items.title: 17.1 Alternating current aur is ki khasiyatein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC and its characteristics (PDF 85-89).

blocks.text: Alternating current (AC) sine ki shakal mein badalta current hai, jise waqt par munhasir sine ya cosine functions se dikhaya ja sakta hai. AC generator ki emf V = Vo sin(wt) (17.1) hai, jahan V waqt t par voltage, Vo is ki zyada se zyada qeemat aur w angular frequency hai (Fig 17.1). Isi tarah current ke liye I = Io sin(wt), jahan I lamhati current aur Io is ki zyada se zyada (peak) qeemat hai.

blocks.title: Alternating current ya voltage
blocks.text: Dauri taur par badalta current ya voltage tab alternating hai jab har chakkar aik time period T le aur us ke do bilkul mutanasib aadhe chakkar hon, aik musbat aur doosra manfi.

Current ke liye har aadhe chakkar ke baad simt ulat jati hai; voltage ke liye har aadhe chakkar ke baad polarity ulat jati hai. Amplitude (peak qeemat) har chakkar mein aik hai, lekin qeemat sifar (crossover) nuqton par sab se tez aur chotiyon par sab se ahista badalti hai.

blocks.alt: Voltage aur waqt ka sabz sine graph ka aik mukammal chakkar, +Vo aur -Vo ke darmiyan; waqt ke mehwar par T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T, aur T par khari lakeer. Chotti par peak value likha hai. Oopar aur neeche dohre teer 1 complete cycle aur time period dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.1: Alternating voltage ki waveform (kitab ki Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Waveform: waqt ke muqable alternating miqdar ka bana rasta.
Cycle (chakkar): musbat aur manfi qeematon ka aik mukammal set.
Time period (T): aik chakkar mukammal karne ka waqt, seconds mein.
Frequency (f): fi second chakkaron ki tadaad, hertz (Hz) mein; f = 1/T.

blocks.text: Average, lamhati, peak aur rms qeematein

AC waveform ki average qeemat chakkar ke kisi hisse par us ki tamam lamhati qeematon ka hisabi aust hai. Poori sine wave (0 se 2 pi) par aust sifar hai, kyunke musbat aur manfi aadhe chakkar aik doosre ko khatam karte hain (Fig 17.2). Is liye AC waveform ka aust aam taur par aik aadhe chakkar (0 se pi) par liya jata hai. Yeh rectification mein ahem hai: rectifier ka output pulsating DC hai, aur full-wave rectified sine wave ke liye Iav = 0.637 Io aur Vav = 0.637 Vo (peak ka 2/pi).

blocks.alt: Voltage (V) aur waqt (t) ka neela sine graph ka aik chakkar, omega t 0 se 2 pi tak, pi/2, pi, 3 pi/2 aur 2 pi nishan zada. Pehle aadhe chakkar ke neeche ka raqba rangeen hai. Surkh dashed lakeerein peak Vo aur average qeemat (2/pi) Vo = 0.637 Vo dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.2: Alternating voltage ki average qeemat (kitab ki Figure 17.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Lamhati qeemat kisi lamhe ki qeemat hai: V = Vo sin(wt). Kyunke w = 2 pi / T = 2 pi f, V = Vo sin(2 pi f t), aur isi tarah I = Io sin(2 pi f t) (17.2). Peak (zyada se zyada) qeemat, Vo ya Io, chakkar ki sab se oonchi qeemat hai, musbat aadhe chakkar ki chotti ya manfi ki tah. Peak-to-peak qeemat musbat chotti se manfi chotti tak ka faasla hai: Vp-p = 2Vo.

blocks.alt: Peak Vo wali narangi sine wave aur chhoti peak wali sabz sine wave aik saath. Dashed lakeerein positive peak Vo, Vrms = Vo/sqrt 2, Vavg = 0.637 Vo aur negative peak -Vo dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.3: Alternating voltage ki rms, average, peak aur p-p qeematein graph par (kitab ki Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 17.3 mein neeli (average) lakeer par bhi Vavg = Vo/sqrt 2 likha hai, jo asal mein rms qeemat hai. Durust: Vrms = Vo/sqrt 2 = 0.707 Vo (narangi lakeer) aur aadhe chakkar ki average Vavg = 0.637 Vo (neeli lakeer, thori neeche). Khaake mein yahi durust qeematein likhi hain.

blocks.title: Root-mean-square (rms) qeemat
blocks.text: Alternating current ki rms (mo'assar) qeemat us mustaqil current ki qeemat hai jo resistor mein alternating current jitni taqat (hararat ka asar) paida kare: Irms = Io / 2 ka square root = 0.707 Io (17.3). Isi tarah Vrms = Vo / 2 ka square root = 0.707 Vo (17.4). Yun rms current peak current ka taqreeban 70 feesad hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Supply ke liye AC, DC se behtar kyun? AC lambe faaslon, shehron ke darmiyan bhi, kam tawanai ke nuqsan ke saath bheja ja sakta hai (transformers se is ka voltage barhaya ghataya ja sakta hai); bohat lambe faaslon par DC bijli ki taqat khota hai.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein
blocks.text: Unche voltage ki bijli ki taarein aksar corona discharge ki wajah se chatakti aur sanasanati hain: conductor ke gird hawa taqatwar electric field se ionise ho jati hai, jis se halki chamak, radio shor aur sanasanahat hoti hai, khaas taur par jab voltage hawa ki tootne ki had (breakdown strength) se barh jaye.

blocks.alt: Current (A) aur waqt (s) ka graph, 0 se 0.35 s tak, har 5 A aur 0.05 s par grid. Narangi sine wave 0 se 17 A ki peak tak jati, -17 A tak girti aur 0.10 s ke period se dohrati hai.
blocks.caption: Misal 17.1 ka graph: current aur waqt (kitab ke Misal 17.1 wale graph ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Alternating current ki peak qeemat Io = 17 A aur period T = 0.10 s hai (kitab ke graph se). t = 0.67 s par current maloom karein. Hal: I = Io sin(2 pi t / T). Yahan t/T = 0.67/0.10 = 6.7, is liye current 6 poore chakkar aur aik ka 0.7 hissa mukammal kar chuka; phase 0.7 x 360 darje = 252 darje hai. sin 252 darje = -0.951, is liye I = 17 A x (-0.951) = -16.2 A: manfi simt mein 16.2 A ka current.

blocks.title: Kitab mein Misal 17.1
blocks.text: Kitab 2 x 3.14 x 0.67 / 0.1 = 42.1 (radian) nikalti hai lekin phir ise 42 darje leti aur sin 42 darje = 0.917 istemal karti hai (sin 42 darje asal mein 0.669 hai), aur I = 15.58 A deti hai. Zawiya radian mein lene par, jaisa formula chahta hai, I = -16.2 A. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Kaise maloom karein ke current alternating hai? Current ki simt dekhein ke badalti hai ya wahi rehti hai: agar dauri taur par ulat'ti hai to current alternating hai; agar hamesha aik taraf behta hai to direct hai. Bina chhue voltage detector (pen tester) ya AC setting par multimeter qaleen ke neeche AC wiring bhi us ke badalte electromagnetic field se pakar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein mains voltage 50 Hz par 220 V rms hai. Is ki peak qeemat, peak-to-peak qeemat aur period kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Vo = 220 x 2 ka square root = 311 V; Vp-p = 2 x 311 = 622 V; T = 1/50 = 0.02 s.

items: V = Vo sin(wt) = Vo sin(2 pi f t); f = 1/T.
Aadhe chakkar ka aust 0.637 Vo; peak-to-peak 2Vo.
rms = peak / sqrt(2) = 0.707 x peak (DC jitni hararat).
